description: This file defines the StoriesTransformer class, which extends AbstractTransformer and provides methods to transform 'story' model objects, including retrieving project info, review text, author info, actions, and generating links. It is part of the Goteo project, specifically within the ModelNormalizer Transformer namespace.

classes.name: StoriesTransformer
classes.description: A class that transforms 'story' model objects, providing methods to retrieve project info, review, author, actions, and URLs.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns formatted information combining the project's name and author's name, along with a shortened review snippet.

methods.name: getReview
methods.description: Returns the review text associated with the model.

methods.name: getAuthor
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the user who authored the model, or a label if unavailable.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an array of actions (edit, translate) available for the story, contingent on user permissions.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Generates a URL link to the story, either for public preview or other types.
